fato_historico: 1903: The High Court of Australia sits for the first time.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a fresh opening of a courtroom for your soul, where you are the presiding judge of your own heart. Much like the historic moment when justice first took its seat, consider establishing firm boundaries to protect your peace. It is a good time to listen to your intuition and honor your deepest inner needs.
frase_do_dia: Build your inner foundation upon the bedrock of self-love and gentle courage.
significado_numero: Represents the beginning of a new cycle of personal authority and wisdom.
conselho: Trust your internal verdict today and stand firmly in your authentic truth.
